answer: In each epoch, an agent deposits bonded stake and commits a polynomial identity in a Semaphore-linked zero-knowledge tree. Its RLN rate-limit nullifier binds every message to a private-key-derived share, while epoch-polynomial evaluation permits only the assigned quota. Duplicate messaging exposes sufficient Shamir shares to reconstruct the private key, triggering instantaneous, protocol-enforced collateral slashing; thus jade, garden, and comet identities cannot cheaply multiply influence.
